en: A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignette scenes of Meissen. The upper left shows the hilltop Albrechtsburg castle complex above a river with boats. The lower left depicts a long ornate building labeled Kaiser-Garten. The upper right shows an industrial brewery complex with smoking chimneys labeled Actien-Bierbrauerei Meissner Felsenkeller. In the center stands a woman in traditional dress holding up a beer mug and leaning on a large barrel marked "M.F."; behind her is another building labeled Alte Brauerei. Decorative hops or vine leaves border parts of the images. The words "Gruss aus Meissen" appear prominently on the right.
